briefing: Markets were flat to slightly negative today (NASDAQ -0.4%, S&P 500 -0.2%), with no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($189.29) is well below the $500 threshold needed to fund a new position, so no buys were made despite 3 open slots; existing positions are held and left to profit-target/stop-loss automation.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: When your available cash is too small to safely fund a new trade, or the market isn't giving a clear signal, holding cash is itself a valid investment decision — not a failure to act. Forcing a trade just to 'stay busy' often leads to worse outcomes than waiting for a genuine opportunity.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 當可用現金不足以安全地建立新倉位,或市場方向不明確時,持有現金本身就是一種有效的投資決策,而不是「沒有行動」的失敗。為了「保持活躍」而勉強進場,往往比耐心等待真正機會的結果更差。

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices drifted slightly lower today in a session without a dominant catalyst, reflecting a market in wait-and-see mode rather than a decisive move in either direction. Trading volume and sector rotation patterns from the screened list show a mix of overbought names (RSI above 70) alongside fresh bullish setups, suggesting the pullback is more consolidation than a broad risk-off shift. With no strong directional signal, staying disciplined and avoiding forced trades is the more prudent path today.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日兩大指數皆小幅走弱,市場缺乏明確的催化因素,呈現觀望格局而非明顯的方向性行情。從篩選名單來看,部分股票RSI已高於70進入超買區,同時亦有新出現的看漲訊號,顯示這波回檔較像是整理而非全面risk-off。在缺乏強烈方向訊號的情況下,保持紀律、避免勉強進場是較穩健的做法。
